content: {"like":["Enjoys heartwarming, family-friendly animated films like Studio Ghibli’s gentle storytelling.","Values strong, charismatic performances from actresses such as Nicole Kidman in biographical dramas.","Prefers fast-paced, action-oriented thrillers with solid lead performances.","Appreciates realistic, grounded portrayals of elderly care settings in medical dramas.","Finds well-crafted, period-accurate war dramas engaging when executed well."],"dislike":["Dislikes uneven, underdeveloped acting from male leads in historical dramas.","Rejects films with excessive, unrealistic gore and overused slow-motion effects.","Avoids series with poor character development and amateurish production values.","Dislikes emotionally heavy, relentlessly sad narratives that feel depressing.","Finds subtitles that fail to function in foreign-language films unacceptable."]}
